
name: Release APK - Self Update

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: 'Manual tag (e.g. v1.0.1)'
        required: false
        default: 'v1.0.1'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: gradle

      - name: Set up Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3

      - name: Install NDK + CMake + Build Tools
        run: |
          set -x
          sdkmanager --install "ndk;27.0.11718014" "cmake;3.22.1" "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;36.0.0" "platform-tools"
          echo "ANDROID_NDK_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/27.0.11718014" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "NDK_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/27.0.11718014" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          ls -lh $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/27.0.11718014 || true
          cmake --version || true

      - name: Grant gradlew permission
        run: chmod +x gradlew

      - name: Show versions
        run: |
          ./gradlew --version
          ./gradlew printVersion || echo "printVersion task not found, skip"
          cat app/build.gradle.kts | grep -n "versionName\|versionCode" | head -20

      - name: Build standardRelease APK
        run: |
          set -x
          # 你的 flavor 是 standard，任務名是 assembleStandardRelease
          # 如果失敗，會嘗試 assembleRelease 作為後備
          ./gradlew assembleStandardRelease --stacktrace --info || ./gradlew assembleRelease --stacktrace --info

      - name: Find APK
        id: find_apk
        run: |
          set -x
          find app/build/outputs -name "*.apk" -type f | tee apk_list.txt
          APK=$(find app/build/outputs -name "*standardRelease*.apk" -type f | head -n 1)
          if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
            APK=$(find app/build/outputs -name "*.apk" -type f | head -n 1)
          fi
          echo "APK=$APK"
          echo "apk_path=$APK" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          ls -lh "$APK"

      - name: Create Release and Upload APK
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          files: ${{ steps.find_apk.outputs.apk_path }}
          generate_release_notes: true
          fail_on_unmatched_files: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload artifact (for debugging)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: apk-and-logs
          path: |
            app/build/outputs/
            app/build/reports/
            apk_list.txt
